remarks: Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac, this charming single story home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,512 square feet of living space! With its inviting curb appeal, beautiful tile roof, covered front porch, and low-maintenance rock landscaping, this property has plenty to offer. Step inside and discover the possibilities of making this home your own! Enjoy the convenience of an attached garage, a spacious driveway providing additional parking, and easy-care landscaping. The home also features a solar energy system with an existing Solar Purchase Agreement.
